competing_explanation: The 40% figure could be a real effect but the n=6 pilot lacks statistical power and methodological rigor to confirm it as stated.
hypothesis_statement: VERDICT: FALSE — the only record addressing C1 (B3) is a re-analysis of an underpowered 6-subject pilot with no washout verification and no confidence interval, so it cannot support the claim that RX-441 increases bioavailability by exactly 40% relative to reference.
predicted_outcome: A properly powered, validated crossover PK study would show a different magnitude or wide CI around the 40% figure, undermining the exact-as-worded claim.
refutation_criterion: A validated, adequately powered study reporting a statistically significant ~40% relative bioavailability increase with a narrow CI would falsify this verdict.
